title: Self-Pay Visit Package Eligibility Matrix by Tier
content:
**Eligibility matrix — Self-Pay Visit Package.** Every tier is sold to self-pay patients without Medicare coverage. The Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package additionally requires a surgery date and the surgeon's post-operative protocol on file.

| Tier | Entry requirements | Medicare beneficiary may buy | May fund a diagnosis also treated under an in-network Insured Plan of Care | Exception where that plan's calendar-year visit limit is used up | Guardian signature below age | Surgeon's protocol on file before purchase | Purchase window after surgery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage | No | No | Yes | 18 years | No | 0 days (not post-surgical) |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage | No | No | Yes | 18 years | No | 0 days (not post-surgical) |
| Core 8-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage | No | No | Yes | 18 years | No | 0 days (not post-surgical) |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage | No | No | Yes | 18 years | No | 0 days (not post-surgical) |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage; surgery date on file; surgical protocol on file | No | No | Yes | 18 years | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | self-pay; no Medicare coverage | No | No | Yes | 18 years | No | 0 days (not post-surgical) |

**Footnotes to the matrix**

1. *Medicare beneficiary* — whether a patient covered by Medicare may buy the package.
2. *In-network same diagnosis* — whether the package may fund visits for a diagnosis also treated under an active in-network Insured Plan of Care.
3. *Exhausted-benefit exception* — whether a patient whose insurance visit limit for the calendar year is used up may buy the package for the same diagnosis.
4. *Guardian signature* — the age in whole years below which a parent or legal guardian must sign the purchase.
5. *Protocol on file* — whether the surgeon's post-operative protocol must be on file before purchase.
6. *Purchase window after surgery* — the calendar days after the surgery date within which the package must be purchased; 0 where the tier is not post-surgical.
